items.textToSpeech: For children under 15, the Population Reference Intakes for vitamin A increase with age and range from 250 micrograms of retinol equivalents per day for those aged 7-11 months, up to 600 micrograms of retinol equivalents per day for those aged 11-14. See the associated table or the source document for full details.
The Population Reference Intake is the level of nutrient intake that will meet the requirements of 97.5% of the individuals in the population. Is there anything else I can help you with?
